author: Robin Marx
description:
In Conan: Cult of the Obsidian Moon by James Lovegrove, Conan the Cimmerian, still mourning his pirate queen Bêlit, trades the seas for the desert, languishing in the Shemitish city-state of Eruk. His last adventure—an attempted burglary foiled by a sabretooth tiger—having ended in disaster, the barbarian searches for a distraction. One such opportunity presents […]
